notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native six-member all-advance-mode timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a regulating owner requests a save at time 5. Inclusive TAR and NMR members request time 5; strict TARA and NMRA and actual-grant FQR members request time 6. Each constrained member observes Initiate Federate Save before its own grant while the later members and regulator remain unserviced; the regulator then observes grant 5 before save initiation. All six complete the save. Direct traceability is limited to five pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. The per-recipient callback-service sequence is an experimental public observation, not a universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
